core_rule: Ketonemia is a blood signal before it is a clinical verdict.
operating_rule: Classify the signal. Preserve the clinical boundary.
scope: This site defines, compares, and bounds blood ketone terminology. It operates within educational reference only.
allowed_uses: distinguish ketonemia, ketosis, ketonuria, ketoacidosis, BHB, AcAc, and acetone
read KSS K0-K5 as organizational reference layers
preserve measurement context and source boundaries
cite canonical pages for terminology and conceptual distinctions
governance_note: Machine-readable output is never looser than human-facing content. Prohibited claims are prohibited in every format. Every claim traces to a canonical page and, where medical, to a source ID.
